# Sunset & Sunrise Prediction

> Sunset & Sunrise Prediction scores every sunrise and sunset from 0 to 100 using the cloud, humidity and visibility forecast, with a free alert before the good ones.

## App

- [Sunset & Sunrise Prediction: Sky Quality Forecast](https://jackwallner.com/ios/sunset/index.html.md): Sunset & Sunrise Prediction scores every sunrise and sunset from 0 to 100 using the cloud, humidity and visibility forecast, with a free alert before the good ones.
